plugins.name: limitswitcher
plugins.description: Feeds Claude Code's live usage to LimitSwitcher, adds /limits (every Claude account at a glance), and runs the Jev compaction it asks for before a swapped session goes on.

plugins.name: jev-compact
plugins.description: Shrinks the tool outputs a session no longer needs with TypeSafe's Jev (OpenRouter) before LimitSwitcher swaps its account, so the new account loads less. No Claude usage.
